Per-member actions inside a conference

Usage:
  plivo voice conferences member [flags]
  plivo voice conferences member [command]

Available Commands:
  deaf        Deafen a member (they can't hear)
  kick        Kick a member from the conference (requires --yes)
  mute        Mute a member
  play        Play audio file(s) into a member's channel
  speak       Speak TTS text to a member
  stop-play   Stop audio playback to a member
  stop-speak  Stop TTS playback to a member
  undeaf      Undeafen a member
  unmute      Unmute a member

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for member

Global Flags:
      --dry-run            print the HTTP request without sending
      --explain            explain what the command will do before executing
      --log-level string   log level: debug|info|warn|error|none (default "warn")
      --no-color           disable colored output
  -o, --output string      output format: table|json (default: table for TTY, json otherwise)
      --profile string     named profile from ~/.plivo/config.toml
  -q, --quiet              suppress non-data output
      --timeout int        request timeout in seconds (default 30)
  -y, --yes                skip confirmation prompts

Use "plivo voice conferences member [command] --help" for more information about a command.
